data/1/entries/3/entries/2/entries/1/ent.english: −5 penalty to passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores; no foraging
data/1/entries/3/entries/2/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 被動感知（{@skill Perception}）值承受 −5 減值；無法覓食
data/1/entries/3/entries/2/entries/1/ent.reason: 保留明確的負號與被動值機制。

data/1/entries/7/entries/3/entries/6/ent.english: A one- to two-foot-tall mushroom with a combustible cap, a single torchstalk burns for 24 hours once lit. There is a 1-in-6 chance that a torchstalk explodes when lit, bursting into a cloud of fiery spores. Creatures within 10 feet of an exploding torchstalk take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) fire damage.
data/1/entries/7/entries/3/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 這種蘑菇高一至兩尺，菌蓋可燃；一株火把菇點燃後可燃燒24小時。點燃時有六分之一的機率爆炸，散成一團燃燒的孢子。爆炸火把菇10尺內的生物受到3（{@dice 1d6}）點火焰傷害。
data/1/entries/7/entries/3/entries/6/ent.reason: 理順可燃菌蓋敘述，保留六分之一機率。

data/1/entries/10/entries/3/entries/15/e.english: The adventurers come across a small ruin hidden in the Underdark. This might be the creation of a subterranean race or a surface ruin that collapsed and sank long ago. If the characters search the ruins, there is a 50 percent chance of them finding {@dice 1d4} trinkets (see chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5|Trinkets}," of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Roll on the Trinkets table or choose appropriate ones.
data/1/entries/10/entries/3/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 冒險者發現幽暗地域中隱藏的一小片廢墟。這可能是地下種族的建築，也可能是很久以前坍塌並沉入地下的地表遺跡。角色若搜索廢墟，有50%的機率找到{@dice 1d4}件小飾物（見{@i 玩家手冊}第5章「{@book 裝備|PHB|5|Trinkets}」）。在小飾物表上擲骰，或選擇合適的物品。
data/1/entries/10/entries/3/entries/15/e.reason: 補回第5章；廢墟是由地表沉入地下，不是沉入地表。

data/5/entries/5/entries/4/entries/5/ent.reason: 保留原文上限，移除新增的0。

data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/4/en.english: The characters encounter a {@creature drow elite warrior} and {@dice 1d8} {@creature drow} fighting a {@creature hezrou} demon. The hezrou has {@dice 2d10 + 45} hit points remaining, while each drow has {@dice 2d6} hit points remaining. The drow elite warrior isn't wounded. Without interference, the drow slay the demon, with the drow elite warrior and {@dice 1d4}−1 drow surviving the encounter. If the characters get involved, the encounter becomes a three-way fight, as neither the drow nor the demon are interested in forming an alliance.
data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 角色們遇見一名{@creature drow elite warrior}和{@dice 1d8}名{@creature drow}，正與一隻{@creature hezrou}惡魔交戰。狂蟾魔剩餘{@dice 2d10 + 45}點生命值，每名卓爾剩餘{@dice 2d6}點生命值，卓爾精英武者則毫髮無傷。如果沒有人介入，卓爾會殺死惡魔，最終只有卓爾精英武者和{@dice 1d4}−1名卓爾存活。如果角色們加入，戰鬥會變成三方混戰，因為卓爾和惡魔都無意結盟。
data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/4/en.reason: 補回遺漏的 −1，不能把存活人數由1d4−1改為1d4。

data/3/entries/17/entries/4/entries/2.english: An {@condition invisible} {@spell wall of force} stands between the Deepking's dais and the characters. Whether the Deepking is of a mind to fight the demon lords is up to you, although like many other duergar in the city, {@creature Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V|OotA|Horgar Steelshadow V} has been touched by the demon lords' madness. Roll on the Indefinite Madness table in {@table indefinite madness||chapter 8} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} to determine Horgar's flaw.
data/3/entries/17/entries/4/entries/2.zh_tw: 一道{@condition invisible}的{@spell wall of force}隔開深王的高臺與角色們。深王是否願意對抗惡魔領主，由你決定；不過，如同城中的許多灰矮人，{@creature Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V|OotA|霍加·鋼影五世}也受到惡魔領主的瘋狂影響。在{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@table indefinite madness||第8章}中擲永久性瘋狂表，決定霍加的缺點。
data/3/entries/17/entries/4/entries/2.reason: 移除重複章號，保留永久性瘋狂表與力場牆。

data/4/entries/5/entries/3/entries/0/ent.english: While the characters remain in Neverlight Grove, their pursuit level remains unchanged, as Ilvara waits to hear from the missing patrol. The drow pursuit resumes when the party leaves the grove. See {@area chapter 2|078|x} for more information.
data/4/entries/5/entries/3/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: 角色们停留在無光林地期間，追擊等級維持不變，因為伊爾瓦拉正在等待失蹤巡邏隊的消息。隊伍離開林地後，卓爾的追擊便會恢復。詳見{@area 第2章|078|x}。
data/4/entries/5/entries/3/entries/0/ent.reason: 清除重複章號；追擊是暫停而非終止。

data/8/entries/6/entries/2.english: Mantol-Derith abuts the Darklake and is roughly six days' travel from Blingdenstone and Menzoberranzan, and 22 days from Gracklstugh via the Darklake locks (see the overview map of the Underdark in {@area chapter 2|051|x}). Characters accompanied by Zhentarim guides approach Mantol-Derith via a subterranean rift. A narrow trail winds up the side of the rift, ending at a secret door in the northwest corner of the trade hub (area 1a).
data/8/entries/6/entries/2.zh_tw: 曼塔-岱瑞絲緊鄰黑暗湖，距離布靈登石城與魔索布萊城各約六天路程；若從格拉克斯圖格經黑暗湖船閘前來，則需22天（見{@area 第2章|051|x}的幽暗地域總覽地圖）。由散塔林會嚮導陪同的角色會經由地下裂谷接近曼塔-岱瑞絲。一條狹窄小徑沿裂谷側壁蜿蜒而上，盡頭是貿易中心西北角的一道暗門（區域1a）。
data/8/entries/6/entries/2.reason: 整理交通資訊並移除重複章號。

data/8/entries/16/entries/3/entries/4/en.english: Each storage building contains {@dice 2d6} crystal vials of exotic perfume worth 100 gp each, {@dice 3d6} crystal bottles of distilled beverages worth 25 gp each, {@dice 1d4} magic items (determined by rolling on Magic Item Table A in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Treasure Tables} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}), and {@dice 2d6} vials of carrion crawler mucus (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Characters also find {@dice 1d10 × 10} pounds of food and {@dice 1d10 × 5} gallons of water stored in each building.
data/8/entries/16/entries/3/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 每座倉庫都有{@dice 2d6}瓶珍奇香水，裝在水晶小瓶中，每瓶價值100金幣；{@dice 3d6}瓶以水晶瓶盛裝的蒸餾飲品，每瓶價值25金幣；{@dice 1d4}件魔法物品（擲{@i 城主指南}{@book 第7章|DMG|7|Treasure Tables}的魔法物品表A決定）；以及{@dice 2d6}瓶食腐蟲黏液（見{@i 城主指南}第8章的「{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}」）。角色也能在每座倉庫中找到{@dice 1d10 × 10}磅食物與{@dice 1d10 × 5}加侖的水。
data/8/entries/16/entries/3/entries/4/en.reason: 補回毒藥章號並明確標示每瓶單價，而非全部的總價。

data/9/entries/6/entries/3/entries/1/ent.english: Roll on the Creature Encounters table in {@area chapter 2|07f|x} or the Darklake Creature Encounters table in {@area chapter 3|103|x}, depending on where the party is traveling.
data/9/entries/6/entries/3/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 依隊伍旅行的地點，在{@area 第2章|07f|x}的生物遭遇表，或{@area 第3章|103|x}的黑暗湖生物遭遇表上擲骰。

data/9/entries/6/entries/3/entries/3/ent.english: A loud argument that has a 50 percent chance of attracting nearby monsters (roll on the Creature Encounters table in {@area chapter 2|07f|x})
data/9/entries/6/entries/3/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 一場大聲爭吵，有50%的機率引來附近的怪物（擲{@area 第2章|07f|x}的生物遭遇表）。

data/13/entries/14/entries/1.english: The engine looks like a working model of the Great Wheel (see chapter 2, "{@book Creating a Multiverse|DMG|2|The Great Wheel}," in the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). It's a 20-foot-diameter sphere built of 1-foot-wide bands of magically hardened and shaped bronze, engraved with arcane symbols. Gaps in the bands show various gears and articulation arms within the sphere, which rotate and shift to represent the relationships between the various known planes of existence.
data/13/entries/14/entries/1.zh_tw: 這個引擎看起來像是一個大輪盤的工作模型（參見第2章「{@book 塑造多元宇宙|DMG|2|The Great Wheel}」，選自{@i 城主指南}）。它是一個直徑為20尺的球體，由1尺寬的魔法加固和成形的青銅帶構成，上面刻有神秘的符號。帶子之間的縫隙顯露出球體內各種齒輪和關節臂，它們旋轉和移動以展示各種已知存在位面之間的關係。
data/13/entries/14/entries/1.reason: 補回大輪宇宙模型的章號。

data/14/entries/4/entries/0.english: Seventy-two miles of twisting passageways separate Araj from Menzoberranzan. Vizeran has a secret route between the two, which he allows the characters to use if they agree to follow his plan. Otherwise, the characters must travel to Menzoberranzan by commonly known routes monitored by drow scouts, patrols, and outposts. If the characters opt to use Vizeran's secret route, the drow archmage's apprentice, Grin Ousstyl (see {@area chapter 12|41b|x}), accompanies the characters at Vizeran's behest, serving as their guide.
data/14/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 阿拉傑與魔索布萊城之間隔著長達七十二英里的曲折通道。維茲蘭掌握一條連通兩地的秘密路線；只要角色們同意遵照他的計畫行動，他就允許他們使用。否則，角色必須走常見路線前往魔索布萊城，而這些路線都受到卓爾偵察兵、巡邏隊與前哨站監視。若角色選擇秘密路線，卓爾大法師的學徒格林·奧斯提爾（見{@area 第12章|41b|x}）會奉維茲蘭之命隨行，擔任嚮導。
data/14/entries/4/entries/0.reason: 修正同意計畫的主詞為角色，並移除重複章號。

data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/3/en.english: If the drow scouts escape and the characters don't follow them, the scouts report to the outpost commander, who organizes a hunting party consisting of her and eight drow (leaving the mage and eight drow to staff the outpost). Use the drow pursuit rules in {@area chapter 2|078|x}, and assume a pursuit level of 4.
data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 如果黑暗精靈偵察兵逃脫，而角色們沒有追蹤他們，偵察兵會向前哨指揮官報告，指揮官會組織一個由她自己和八名黑暗精靈組成的狩獵隊（留下法師和八名黑暗精靈守衛前哨）。使用{@area 第二章|078|x}中的黑暗精靈追擊規則，並假設追擊等級為4。

data/16/entries/3/entries/3/items/2.english: Baphomet and Yeenoghu are absent if the characters activated the Maze Engine (see {@area chapter 14|4c8|x}) and the 81–100 result on the Maze Engine Effects table came up.
data/16/entries/3/entries/3/items/2.zh_tw: 若角色啟動過迷宮引擎（見{@area 第14章|4c8|x}），且在迷宮引擎效果表上擲出81–100，巴弗滅與耶諾古便不會在場。
data/16/entries/3/entries/3/items/2.reason: 移除重複章號，保留結果範圍及條件。

data/16/entries/3/entries/5/entries/0.english: If the adventurers need some extra help in their epic final battle at the end of the campaign, consider the following option involving {@creature Jimjar|OotA}, the deep gnome gambler they met in the drow slave pen in {@area chapter 1|008|x} of the adventure.
data/16/entries/3/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 若冒險者在戰役尾聲的史詩決戰中需要額外援助，可以考慮以下選項：讓{@creature Jimjar|OotA}介入。他就是角色們在本冒險{@area 第1章|008|x}的卓爾奴隸牢中遇見的地底侏儒賭徒。
data/16/entries/3/entries/5/entries/0.reason: 移除重複章號並整理句序。

data/1/entries/10/entries/4/entries/16/e.reason: 依中文句序呈現種族與姓名。
依中文句序呈現種族與姓名。
依中文句序呈現種族與姓名。

data/3/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1/ent.english: Firelight illuminates massive columns with structures built around their bases. The cold air of the Underdark is becoming warmer even at this distance, and you can now see a variety of piers made from zurkhwood, stone, and plain rock jutting out along the edge of a huge cavern.
data/3/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 火光照亮巨大的石柱，柱腳周圍環繞著建築。即使相隔這麼遠，幽暗地域的冰冷空氣也已漸漸變暖。如今你們能看見巨洞邊緣伸出的各式碼頭，有的以祖克木搭建，有的以石材砌成，有的則直接利用天然岩石。
data/3/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1/ent.reason: 移除混入朗讀文字的虛構材料解說及編輯指示。

data/3/entries/9/entries/7/entries/4/ent.english: Catching {@creature Droki|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) is the objective of quests from Errde Blackskull (see "Overlake Hold") and Gartokkar Xundorn (see "{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s Lair"), but if the characters pursue the courier openly, he flees for the West Cleft District. Pursuing characters quickly lose sight of the derro as he vanishes into the crowd. See "Finding {@creature Droki|OotA}" in the "Whorlstone Tunnels" section for more information on what {@creature Droki|OotA} is carrying if the characters catch him.
data/3/entries/9/entries/7/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 捕捉{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}（見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）是艾德·黑顱（見"湖上堡"）和加爾托卡·桑多恩（見"{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的巢穴"）的任務目標，但如果角色們公開追蹤信使，他會逃往西裂谷區。追蹤的角色們很快就在人群中失去了德羅的蹤跡。有關角色們如果抓住他，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}攜帶了什麼的更多資訊，請見"渦石隧道"部分中的"尋找{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}"。
data/3/entries/9/entries/7/entries/4/ent.reason: 翻譯引用標題旁的英文殘留，保留連結識別碼。

data/3/entries/15/entries/6/entries/3.english: {@creature Droki|OotA}'s route takes him all around the Whorlstone Tunnels, and he's too scatterbrained to notice anyone following him. {@creature Droki|OotA}'s route is marked with red arrows on the map of the Whorlstone Tunnels. He eats a pygmywort mushroom whenever he needs to navigate a narrow tunnel. As he approaches areas 7 and 8, he eats a bigwig mushroom, reverts to normal size, delivers the Gray Ghost parcel (see "Treasure"), and collects his payment from Lorthio the {@creature duergar alchemist|OotA} (see area 8). {@creature Droki|OotA} then heads north to area 9, where he sneaks quietly around the central pool so as not to disturb its occupant. Upon reaching area 11, he greets the derro there before eating another pygmywort mushroom and traveling through the narrow tunnel leading to area 12. He eats another bigwig and reverts to normal size before making his delivery to the cultists in that area. After visiting the cultists, {@creature Droki|OotA} makes his way out of the Whorlstone Tunnels.
data/3/entries/15/entries/6/entries/3.zh_tw: {@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的路線貫穿整個渦石隧道，他太心不在焉了，沒有注意到有人跟蹤他。{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}的路線在渦石隧道的地圖上用紅色箭頭標記。每當他需要穿過狹窄的隧道時，就會吃一個侏儒wort蘑菇。當他接近7號和8號區域時，他會吃一個大鬍子蘑菇，恢復正常體型，遞送灰鬼包裹（見"寶藏"），並從{@creature duergar alchemist|OotA|灰矮人鍊金術士}洛希歐（見8號區域）那裡收取他的報酬。然後，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}向北前往9號區域，他悄悄地繞過中央水池，以免打擾那裡的居住者。到達11號區域後，他向那裡的德羅問好，然後吃另一個侏儒wort蘑菇，穿過通往12號區域的狹窄隧道。在向那個區域的邪教徒遞送之前，他又吃了一個大鬍子並恢復正常體型。拜訪過邪教徒後，{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}離開了渦石隧道。
data/3/entries/15/entries/6/entries/3.reason: 按中文句序呈現姓名，蘑菇由語境術語表統一。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/14/e.english: A {@creature crawling claw} wearing an obsidian ring on one stubby finger (see "Treasure") lurks amid the offal mounds. These mounds are {@quickref difficult terrain||3} to Small and Medium creatures, and the fungi growing atop them provide cover to Tiny creatures. The shriveled gray hand once belonged to Pelek the svirfneblin (see "Development").
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/14/e.zh_tw: 一隻{@creature crawling claw}潛伏在內臟堆中，短粗的手指上戴著黑曜石戒指（見「寶藏」）。對小型與中型生物而言，這些堆積物是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}；堆上生長的真菌則能為微型生物提供掩護。這隻乾癟的灰色手掌原本屬於地底侏儒佩勒克（見「後續發展」）。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/14/e.reason: 修正掩護適用的體型：Tiny為微型，並非小型。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: If the characters capture and interrogate Pliinki, she laughs at their folly as she tells them that the Whorlstone Tunnels are nowhere near the surface. She believes the obelisk was hidden here by Diirinka, the derro god, and that it contains "unimaginable power." Pliinki and her fellow savants hope to harness the obelisk's power and use it to conquer Gracklstugh.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 如果角色俘虜並審問普林基，她會嘲笑他們的愚蠢，告訴他們渦石隧道根本不靠近地表。她相信迪洛矮人之神迪林卡把方尖碑藏在這裡，其中蘊藏著「難以想像的力量」。普林基與其他學者希望掌控方尖碑的力量，用來征服格拉克斯圖格。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.reason: 移除基稿新增的重複中英括註。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: If the characters describe the obelisk to Gartokkar Xundorn, he assumes that is what the Gray Ghosts are using to wreak havoc in Gauntlgrym and dispatches a force to study it. Each character earns 100 XP for completing the task set for them by the Keepers. Award each character an additional 150 XP if the party delivers the red dragon egg to either the Keepers or to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 如果角色向加爾托卡·桑多恩描述方尖碑，他會認為灰鬼正是利用它在岡特格瑞姆製造混亂，並派部隊前去研究。完成火焰守護者交付的任務，每名角色獲得100 XP。如果隊伍把紅龍蛋交給火焰守護者或{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}，每名角色再額外獲得150 XP。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.reason: 清除英文及重複括註；岡特格瑞姆依英文原文保留，不擅自改成另一城市。

data/3/entries/17/entries/0.english: The Hold of the Deepking stands south of Laduguer's Furrow and north of {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s lair. When the characters first lay eyes on it, read the following boxed text aloud to the players.
data/3/entries/17/entries/0.zh_tw: 深王堡位於拉杜格溝壑南側、{@creature Themberchaud|OotA}的巢穴北側。角色第一次看見它時，請向玩家朗讀以下框內文字。
data/3/entries/17/entries/0.reason: 清除英文殘留與重複括註。

data/4/entries/4/entries/4/entries/3/ent.reason: 移除基稿新增的翻譯指示，保留原文註腳星號。

data/5/entries/5/entries/4/entries/2.english: If the circle is used to cast a spell that summons an earth elemental, the spell's duration becomes {@dice 1d4 + 6} days and the spell requires no concentration. The summoned elemental never becomes hostile toward the spell's caster or its companions. To gain these benefits, the caster must provide material components in the form of gems with a total value of 10 gp per Hit Die of the elemental summoned.
data/5/entries/5/entries/4/entries/2.zh_tw: 若使用這座法陣施放召喚土元素的法術，法術持續時間會變成{@dice 1d4 + 6}天，且不需要專注。召喚出的元素絕不會敵視施法者或其同伴。要獲得這些好處，施法者必須提供寶石作為材料成分；寶石總價值為所召喚元素每顆生命骰10金幣。
data/5/entries/5/entries/4/entries/2.reason: 統一專注與生命骰術語，清楚說明材料成本。

data/5/entries/13/entries/2/entries/3.english: The trapped svirfneblin is named {@creature Mev Flintknapper|OotA} (use the {@creature veteran} statistics in the {@i Monster Manual}, but also give Mev the Stone Camouflage, Gnome Cunning, and Innate Spellcasting features of a {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}). He has already taken 10 acid damage and takes another 21 ({@dice 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns until pulled free with a successful {@dc 12} Strength check. The attempt requires an action, and any creature making the attempt takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) acid damage is it reaches into the cube.
data/5/entries/13/entries/2/entries/3.zh_tw: 被困的深地侏儒名叫{@creature Mev Flintknapper|OotA|梅夫·弗林特納普}（使用{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的{@creature veteran||老兵}資料，但梅夫還擁有{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}的石頭偽裝、侏儒狡詐和天生施法能力）。他已經受到了10點酸蝕傷害，並且在立方體每回合開始時還會受到21點（{@dice 6d6}）酸蝕傷害，直到透過一個成功的{@dc 12}力量檢定將他拉出來。這個嘗試需要一個動作，任何進行嘗試的生物在將手伸入立方體時會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）酸蝕傷害。

data/8/entries/20/entries/2/entries/0.english: If {@creature Lorthuun|OotA} is killed, {@dice 1d4} of its eyestalks survive intact. Should {@creature Peebles|OotA} the svirfneblin happen upon the beholder's remains, he uses a flint knife to remove the intact eyestalks, then tucks them in his bag for safe delivery to Xazaz the Eyemonger (see "Follow-Up Encounters").
data/8/entries/20/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 若{@creature Lorthuun|OotA}被殺死，牠有{@dice 1d4}根眼梗能保持完好。若地底侏儒{@creature Peebles|OotA}偶然發現眼魔的遺骸，他會用燧石小刀切下完好的眼梗，放進袋中，準備安全送交眼商札札克斯（見「後續遭遇」）。
data/8/entries/20/entries/2/entries/0.reason: 將原文Xazaz拼寫變體統一為同一NPC Xazax的全站譯名。

data/9/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: Sir Aljanor has made his peace with Tyr and expects to die. He is disappointed if good lives are lost in a foolish attempt to rescue him. If he survives, he accepts any offer to join the party's expeditionary force and is quick to assume a leadership role.
data/9/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 阿爾詹諾爵士已與提爾和解，並做好赴死的準備。若有人愚蠢地試圖營救他，卻讓善良的人因此喪命，他會感到失望。若他存活下來，便願意接受加入隊伍遠征軍的任何邀請，並迅速承擔領導職責。
data/9/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.reason: 翻譯爵士稱謂，修正party被誤譯為黨派。

data/12/entries/3/entries/12/entries/1.english: The cave floor is strewn with gnawed bones—the remains of dead dwarves and drow. A circular pit, nine feet deep, holds six captives—two {@creature drow} and four shield dwarf {@creature Commoner||commoners}. These unfortunates were separated from larger groups (see "{@area Random Encounters|42d|x}" earlier in this chapter) and captured by the troglodytes. Every couple of days, one of them is eaten by the tribe. The captives are filthy and weak; each has four levels of {@condition exhaustion} and 1 hit point remaining. Any of the captives can explain the nature of the conflict between H'slaat and S'slaar. If freed, the drow immediately flee into the Underdark, but the dwarves offer to join the expeditionary force if the adventurers liberate them. The drow are male members of House Melarn and are named Rinil and Xol. The shield dwarves hail from the Silver Marches and are named Dauthorn Brightmantle (male), Traldak Xornbane (male), Zulia Stonewhisper (female), and Hargritt Hammerhome (female).
data/12/entries/3/entries/12/entries/1.zh_tw: 洞穴地面上散落著被啃咬的骨頭——死去的矮人和黑暗精靈的殘骸。一個九尺深的圓形坑中關押著六名俘虜——兩名{@creature drow||卓爾}和四名盾矮人{@creature Commoner||平民}。這些不幸的人被從較大的群體中分離出來（見本章前面的"{@area 隨機遭遇|42d|x}"），並被穴蜥人俘虜。每隔幾天，他們中的一個就會被部落吃掉。俘虜們骯髒而虛弱；每個都有四個等級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，只剩下1點生命值。任何一名俘虜都可以解釋赫斯拉特和斯斯拉爾之間的衝突性質。如果被釋放，黑暗精靈會立即逃入幽暗地域，但如果冒險者解放了他們，矮人們願意加入遠徵軍。這些黑暗精靈是梅拉恩家族的男性成員，名叫瑞尼爾和佐爾。盾矮人來自銀月聯邦，名叫道索恩·亮篷（男性）、特拉爾達克·石鼎獸剋星（男性）、祖莉亞·石語（女性）和哈格里特·錘家（女性）。
data/12/entries/3/entries/12/entries/1.reason: 修正Silver Marches地名誤譯以及Xornbane姓氏漏譯。

data/14/entries/9/entries/6/entries/5/en.reason: 移除基稿新增、非原文的翻譯說明。

data/14/entries/10/entries/1/entries/1.english: If Quenthel learns that adventurers are trying to rid the Underdark of its demon lord menace, she doesn't stand in their way (see "{@adventure Private Meetings|OotA|14}") and even allows them to travel through the city unmolested.
data/14/entries/10/entries/1/entries/1.zh_tw: 如果奎恩瑟得知冒險者們試圖清除地下世界中的惡魔領主威脅，她不會阻撓他們（見"{@adventure 私人會面|OotA|14}"），甚至允許他們平安無事地穿越城市。
data/14/entries/10/entries/1/entries/1.reason: 刪除基稿額外插入的英文書號。

data/14/entries/10/entries/2/entries/0.english: Bregan D'aerthe is a mercenary company with more power and influence in Menzoberranzan than all the lesser noble houses combined. Bregan D'aerthe benefits from its close ties with House Baenre. The company's founder and leader, Jarlaxle, is brother to both Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} and Archmage Gromph Baenre, though this fact isn't widely known.
data/14/entries/10/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶是一支傭兵團，在魔索布萊城的權力與影響力，比所有小貴族家族加起來還要大。它與班瑞家族關係密切，並從中受益。傭兵團的創辦人兼領袖賈拉索，與主母{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA}及大法師貢夫·班瑞是兄弟姊妹；不過，知道這件事的人並不多。
data/14/entries/10/entries/2/entries/0.reason: 清除英文頭銜與重複人名括註。

data/16/entries/4/entries/0.english: After running any events you wish from "The Battle," the struggle between the demon lords comes to an end as Demogorgon proves why he is known as the Prince of Demons.
data/16/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 演完「戰鬥」一節中你想採用的事件後，惡魔領主之間的混戰終於落幕，狄摩高根也展現了自己何以被稱為惡魔之王。
data/16/entries/4/entries/0.reason: 翻譯殘留的章節引用標題。

data/17/entries/2/entries/1/rows/3/1.english: You once worked for Davra Jassur, a Zhentarim "troubleshooter" recruiting promising new talent for the Black Network. She helped you get your start as an adventurer, and you owe her for that.
data/17/entries/2/entries/1/rows/3/1.zh_tw: 你曾為達芙拉·賈瑟工作。她是散塔林會的一名「排難專家」，負責為黑網招募有潛力的新血。她曾幫你踏上冒險者之路，因此你欠她一份人情。

data/3/entries/9/entries/11/entries/1/en.english: If the characters rescued Werz Saltbaron from the assassins (see "Darklake Docks"), he meets them at the Shattered Spire at the designated date and time. As modest thanks for saving him, he gives each character an obsidian gemstone worth 10 gp. He then offers them a job, delivering a sack full of raw gemstones (worth 100 gp total) to a svirfneblin named Kazook Pickshine in Blingdenstone, no questions asked.
data/3/entries/9/entries/11/entries/1/en.zh_tw: 如果角色們從刺客手中救出了沃茲·鹽爵（見"黑暗湖碼頭"），他會在約定的日期和時間在破碎尖塔與他們見面。作為對他救命之恩的微薄感謝，他給每個角色一個價值10金幣的黑曜石寶石。然後，他為他們提供了一份工作，將一袋生寶石（總共價值100金幣）送到布靈登石城，交給一個名叫卡祖克·閃鎬的地底侏儒那裡，不問任何問題。
data/3/entries/9/entries/11/entries/1/en.reason: 補回運送寶石的目的地。

data/4/entries/14/entries/3/entries/0.english: This circle is the smallest in Neverlight Grove, since it is merely the temporary home for restless myconids that brave the Underdark as scouts, patrols, and pathfinders.
data/4/entries/14/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 這是無光林地最小的環社，因為它只是那些不安於室、勇闖幽暗地域擔任斥候、巡邏者與探路者的菌人暫時的家。
data/4/entries/14/entries/3/entries/0.reason: 補回外出探索幽暗地域的地點，整理圈社描述。

data/7/entries/4/entries/20/entries/3.english: The possibility that the demon lords of the Abyss are active in the Underdark is a threat the Lords' Alliance can't ignore.
data/7/entries/4/entries/20/entries/3.zh_tw: 來自無底深淵的惡魔領主可能正在幽暗地域活動；這是領主聯盟無法忽視的威脅。
data/7/entries/4/entries/20/entries/3.reason: 修正活動所在地：幽暗地域，而非無底深淵。

data/2/entries/10/entries/1/items/1.english: Staying a short while in Sloobludop can provide a respite from pursuit, since the drow are reluctant to provoke the kuo-toa needlessly. Reduce the pursuit level by 1 while the characters consider their next move.
data/2/entries/10/entries/1/items/1.zh_tw: 在斯盧布多普短暫停留可以為逃避追蹤提供喘息之機，因為卓爾不願無端挑釁寇濤魚人。當角色們考慮下一步行動時，降低追蹤等級1。
data/2/entries/10/entries/1/items/1.reason: 修正追兵種族：原文為卓爾，並非地精。

data/3/entries/0.english: Visitors to the duergar city of Gracklstugh are greeted by its hot and acrid air, followed by the angry red glare of the eternally burning smelters fueling the city's metal works, its clanging heart, and the forges kept alive by the flames of {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, the red dragon that holds the title of Wyrmsmith. Gracklstugh toils endlessly, its smiths churning out the best armor and weapons among the Underdark races. Those who do business here refer to Gracklstugh as "the City of Blades."
data/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 來到灰矮人城市格拉克斯圖格的遊客首先會感受到這裡熾熱而刺鼻的空氣，接著是永遠燃燒的熔爐所散發出的憤怒紅焰，這些熔爐為城市的金屬加工提供動力，是其喧囂的心臟，而被{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的火焰所維持的熔爐更是永不停歇，這位紅龍冠有鑄匠大師的頭銜。格拉克斯圖格無休止地勞作，其鐵匠們生產出了幽暗地域種族中最好的盔甲和武器。在這裡做生意的商人們習慣稱格拉克斯圖格為"刀鋒之城"。

data/10/entries/5/entries/2/entries/4/en.english: Urmas, the Keeper of the Present, is the busiest of all the librarians. He commands a vast network of magically augmented subterranean beasts, which he uses as messengers, bringing and sending news from giants throughout the Underdark and sometimes from the "dream" of the surface world. Urmas exchanges messages with Stonespeaker Hgraam (see {@area chapter 4|15d|x}), keeping abreast of events as they pertain to the stone giant community in the duergar city of Gracklstugh.
data/10/entries/5/entries/2/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 烏爾馬斯，現在檔案館的守護者，是所有圖書管理員中最忙碌的。他指揮著一個龐大的魔法增強地下生物網路，他使用它們作為信使，從幽暗地域的巨人那裡帶來和傳送新聞，有時甚至來自"夢"中的地表世界。烏爾馬斯與石語者哈格拉姆交換訊息（見{@area 第四章|15d|x}），瞭解與灰矮人城市格拉克斯圖格的石巨人社群相關的事件。
data/10/entries/5/entries/2/entries/4/en.reason: 補回灰矮人城市的限定。

data/8/entries/17/entries/2/entries/2.english: A 20-foot-high stone building stands in the northeast corner of the warehouse. Inside this unlocked building, Ghuldur Flagonfist and Krimgol Muzgardt (a pair of male {@creature duergar}) are interrogating Yantha Coaxrock, an unarmed female monster deep gnome suffering from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) that makes her tell lies, even at the risk of harming herself and others. The duergar have dressed her in a robe sewn with gemstones (see "Treasure" below) and suspended her above the mouth of Ghuldur's "pet"—a hungry {@creature xorn}. Ghuldur grasps the rope from which she hangs and is threatening to feed her to the xorn unless she divulges the location of the gem she stole from Krimgol.
data/8/entries/17/entries/2/entries/2.zh_tw: 一座20尺高的石質建築矗立在倉庫的東北角。在這座未上鎖的建築內，古爾杜·酒壺拳和克林戈·穆茲加特（一對男性{@creature duergar||灰矮人}）正在審訊一個手無寸鐵的女性地底侏儒——受到一種無限期瘋狂影響的揚薩·寇克斯洛克（見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，位於{@i 城主指南}第8章），這種瘋狂使她不斷撒謊，甚至不惜傷害自己和他人。杜爾加矮人給她穿了一件縫有寶石的長袍（見下文"寶藏"部分），並將她懸掛在古爾杜的"寵物"——一隻飢餓的{@creature xorn||石鼎獸}的嘴上方。古爾杜抓住了懸掛她的繩子，威脅要將她餵給石鼎獸，除非她交代從克林戈那裡偷走的寶石的下落。
data/8/entries/17/entries/2/entries/2.reason: 理順原文unarmed female monster deep gnome的表達，保留NPC身分與瘋狂效果。

data/3/entries/15/entries/3/entries/2/en.english: The narrowest tunnels are barely 2 feet wide at their widest points. A Tiny creature can move through these tunnels unimpeded, while a Small creature must squeeze to pass through them. Medium and larger creatures can't fit through these narrow passageways.
data/3/entries/15/entries/3/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 最狹窄的隧道，即使最寬處也僅有2尺。微型生物能不受阻礙地穿行，小型生物則必須擠身通過。中型及更大的生物無法進入這些狹窄通道。
data/3/entries/15/entries/3/entries/2/en.reason: 修正Tiny、Small、Medium體型階級，避免自相矛盾。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/5/en.english: Tiny creatures can move through the thicket at no penalty. For Small and Medium creatures, the thicket is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. While in the thicket, Tiny and Small creatures have {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against Medium creatures and can hide.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 微型生物能在菇叢中移動，不受任何減值。對小型與中型生物而言，菇叢是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。身處菇叢時，微型與小型生物對抗中型生物時具有{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}，且可以躲藏。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/5/en.reason: 修正體型與half cover的掩護等級。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/8/en.english: The pit is 5 feet deep and filled with various kinds of fungi. It is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for Small and Medium creatures, and Tiny creatures have {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} while amid the fungi.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/8/en.zh_tw: 這座坑深5尺，長滿各種真菌。對小型與中型生物而言，這裡是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}；微型生物身處真菌叢中時則具有{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/8/en.reason: 修正微型生物與半身掩護。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/13/e.english: The crack in the floor by the east wall is surrounded by a thick fungus patch that is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for Small and Medium characters, and provides {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} for Tiny creatures. Growing among the common fungi are {@dice 2d6} bigwigs and {@dice 2d6} pygmyworts.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/13/e.zh_tw: 東牆旁的地板裂縫被濃密菇叢包圍；對小型與中型角色而言，這裡是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，並能為微型生物提供{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}。普通真菌間生長著{@dice 2d6}株巨冠菇和{@dice 2d6}株縮身菇。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/13/e.reason: 修正體型、半身掩護及兩種魔法蘑菇的名稱。

data/3/entries/15/entries/3/entries/3/en.english: The Whorlstone Tunnels are suffused with {@i faerzress} (see "{@area Faerzress|05f|x}" in chapter 2 for effects). {@i Faerzress} has also altered the physical appearance of the complex, creating spiral patterns on the walls and ceilings. These spirals are what give the complex its name. Because of these weird spiraling patterns, saving throws to resist {@i faerzress}-induced madness are made with disadvantage.
data/3/entries/15/entries/3/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 渦石隧道充滿了{@i 妖光}（見第2章中的"{@area 妖光|05f|x}"瞭解效果）。{@i 妖光}還改變了這個建築群的物理外觀，在牆壁和天花板上形成了螺旋圖案。這些螺旋圖案賦予了這個建築群它的名字。由於這些奇怪的螺旋圖案，抵抗{@i 妖光}引起的瘋狂的豁免檢定具有劣勢。
data/3/entries/15/entries/3/entries/3/en.reason: 明確使用規則術語「劣勢」，不是泛指不利情勢。

data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1.english: The terrace between the top of the stairs and the gate has a slight upward slope. The slope imposes disadvantage on checks made to ram the gate.
data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1.zh_tw: 樓梯頂部和大門之間的露臺有輕微的上坡。這個斜坡使試圖撞開大門的檢定具有劣勢。
data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1.reason: 明確使用規則術語「劣勢」，不是泛指不利情勢。

data/5/entries/23/entries/9/entries/3.english: The crystals here can be used as countermeasures against Neheedra's gaze. A creature with one hand free can hold a crystal to its eyes, gaining advantage on the Constitution saving throw made against Neheedra's gaze. However, the creature makes attack rolls with disadvantage.
data/5/entries/23/entries/9/entries/3.zh_tw: 這裡的水晶可以用來作為對抗妮希德拉視線的對策。一隻手空閒的生物可以拿著水晶放在眼前，從而在對抗妮希德拉視線的體質豁免檢定時獲得優勢。然而，該生物進行攻擊擲骰時具有劣勢。
data/5/entries/23/entries/9/entries/3.reason: 明確使用規則術語「劣勢」，不是泛指不利情勢。

data/14/entries/13/entries/3/entries/2.english: If the tower goes on alert (as indicated in some of the encounter descriptions), all characters have disadvantage when making their group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.
data/14/entries/13/entries/3/entries/2.zh_tw: 如果塔樓進入警戒狀態（如某些遭遇描述中所指出的），所有角色在進行團隊敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定時都具有劣勢。
data/14/entries/13/entries/3/entries/2.reason: 明確使用規則術語「劣勢」，不是泛指不利情勢。

data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.english: {@b Level 1} has a broad antechamber and audience hall.
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.zh_tw: {@b 第1層}有寬敞的前廳與覲見廳。
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.reason: Level在此為塔樓樓層，不是法術環級；補回第4及6層缺漏的房間功能。

data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.english: {@b Level 2} contains kitchens, storage, and currently disused servants' quarters.
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.zh_tw: {@b 第2層}有廚房、儲藏室，以及目前閒置的僕役住所。
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.reason: Level在此為塔樓樓層，不是法術環級；補回第4及6層缺漏的房間功能。

data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.english: {@b Level 3} houses guest bedchambers and a torture chamber for "special guests."
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.zh_tw: {@b 第3層}有客房，以及為「特殊客人」準備的刑求室。
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.reason: Level在此為塔樓樓層，不是法術環級；補回第4及6層缺漏的房間功能。

data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.english: {@b Level 4} contains Vizeran's library and laboratory.
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.zh_tw: {@b 第4層}是維茲蘭的圖書館與實驗室。
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.reason: Level在此為塔樓樓層，不是法術環級；補回第4及6層缺漏的房間功能。

data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.english: {@b Level 5} contains the archmage's private chambers.
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.zh_tw: {@b 第5層}是大法師的私人寢居。
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.reason: Level在此為塔樓樓層，不是法術環級；補回第4及6層缺漏的房間功能。

data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.english: {@b Level 6} is Vizeran's sanctum at the tower's peak, where he spends his time in contemplation and study.
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.zh_tw: {@b 第6層}位於塔頂，是維茲蘭的密室；他在這裡冥想與研究。
data/11/entries/3/entries/1/entries/0/it.reason: Level在此為塔樓樓層，不是法術環級；補回第4及6層缺漏的房間功能。

data/3/entries/9/entries/7/entries/4/ent.english: If the characters decide to wait for {@creature Droki|OotA} to enter the West Cleft or somehow follow him here, use the chase rules in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Chases} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, adapting the results for urban complications to a cave full of hateful derro. If {@creature Droki|OotA} loses them, the characters must resort to less convenient means of finding the Whorlstone Tunnels.
data/3/entries/9/entries/7/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們決定等待{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}進入西裂隙或設法跟隨他來到這裡，請使用{@book 城主指南|DMG}中的{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Chases}規則，並將城市複雜環境調整為充滿仇恨的迪洛矮人洞穴。如果{@creature Droki|OotA|卓奇}甩掉了他們，角色們將不得不採用不太方便的方法來尋找渦石隧道。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: A female derro stands close to the obelisk, gently patting and stroking its surface. The obelisk flashes once, the glow of {@i faerzress} around the cavern flaring in response. The derro squeals with glee as she snatches an object up from the ground, then writes something down in a small notebook.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 一位女性迪洛矮人站在方尖碑旁，輕輕拍打併撫摸著它的表面。方尖碑閃爍了一次，洞穴周圍的{@i 妖光}也隨之閃爍了一下。迪洛矮人高興地尖叫著抓起地上的一個物體，然後在一個小筆記本上寫下了一些東西。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/11/e.english: A large gate made of iron bars blocks the northwest entrance and is usually locked. One of the derro cultists carries the key. The lock can be opened with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. A creature with a Strength of 20 or higher can force the gate open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength check.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/11/e.zh_tw: 一扇由鐵條製成的大門擋住了西北入口，通常上鎖。其中一名迪洛矮人邪教徒攜帶著鑰匙。使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定可以開啟鎖。力量達到20或更高的生物可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量檢定強行開啟大門。

data/5/entries/23/entries/8/entries/4/en.english: Among the remains of the earth elemental, the characters can find an {@item Elemental Gem||earth elemental gem}. Before they can use it, however, it must receive a {@spell remove curse} spell from a priest of the Stoneheart Enclave. Otherwise, the elemental summoned by the gem is always hostile toward its summoner. The characters can also harvest samples from the bodies of the corrupted elemental and the gargoyles for Nomi Pathshutter (see "Stoneheart Quarry" in the "Blingdenstone Outskirts" section).
data/5/entries/23/entries/8/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 在土元素的殘骸中，角色們可以找到一顆{@item Elemental Gem||土元素寶石}。然而，在使用它之前，它必須接受石心聚落的牧師施展的{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術。否則，由寶石召喚出的元素總是對召喚者懷有敵意。角色們還可以從被腐化的元素和石像鬼的身體上採集樣本，交給諾米·封徑（見"布靈登石城郊區"部分中的"石心採石場"）。
data/5/entries/23/entries/8/entries/4/en.reason: 翻譯交叉引用標題的英文殘留。

data/2/entries/14/entries/0.english: A half-dozen kuo-toan keelboats are moored here. Although kuo-toa will negotiate terms for ferrying the characters across the Darklake, none leave without permission (see below). Party members can attempt to steal one or more of the boats, but doing so requires a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check (and the kuo-toa are able to sense {@condition invisible} creatures). The kuo-toa pursue any stolen boats, intending to capture the thieves as offerings to appease their gods.
data/2/entries/14/entries/0.zh_tw: 六艘寇濤魚人的龍骨船停泊在此。雖然寇濤魚人會與角色們商議渡過黑暗湖的條件，但未經允許，沒有船會離開（見下文）。隊伍成員可以嘗試偷取一艘或多艘船，但這需要成功的 {@dc 16} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定（且寇濤魚人能感知到 {@condition invisible||隱形} 的生物）。寇濤魚人會追捕任何被盜的船隻，意圖抓住竊賊作為獻祭以安撫他們的神明。

data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/7/en.english: The characters encounter a {@creature drow mage} riding on the back of a {@creature stone golem} carved from stone and shaped like a giant spider. The mage rides in a howdah that provides {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against attacks from the ground. Escorting the mage are {@dice 2d4} {@creature Drow Elite Warrior||drow elite warriors} mounted on {@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|giant riding lizards} (use the statistics at the end of {@area chapter 8|34c|x}). These drow fight to the death to protect their territory.
data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/7/en.zh_tw: 角色遇見一名{@creature drow mage}，騎在一尊巨蜘蛛形狀的{@creature stone golem}背上。法師乘坐的鞍轎能對抗來自地面的攻擊，提供{@quickref Cover||3||半身掩護}。護衛是{@dice 2d4}名騎乘{@creature Giant Riding Lizard|OotA|乘用巨蜥}的{@creature Drow Elite Warrior||卓爾精英武者}（使用{@area 第8章|34c|x}末尾的數據）。這些卓爾會為了保護領地而戰至最後一刻。
data/14/entries/4/entries/3/entries/7/en.reason: 修正騎乘關係：法師騎在蜘蛛形石魔像上，不是石魔像騎法師。

data/10/entries/4/entries/3/entries/1.english: A small group of characters scouting can sneak up on {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} with a successful {@dc 10} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. Any characters who observe the basilisk can note that it keeps its eyes downcast, as if consciously trying to control its petrifying gaze. When {@creature Veldyskar|OotA} becomes aware of the characters, he calls them over, speaking in all the languages he knows until he determines that the characters understand Common.
data/10/entries/4/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 一小隊角色偵察時，如果透過了 {@dc 10} 的群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，可以悄悄接近 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾}。任何觀察石化蜥蜴的角色都會注意到它一直低垂著眼睛，彷彿有意識地試圖控制其石化凝視。當 {@creature Veldyskar|OotA|維爾迪斯卡爾} 意識到角色的存在時，他會召喚他們過來，用他所知道的所有語言說話，直到他確定角色們理解了通用語。
data/10/entries/4/entries/3/entries/1.reason: 修正basilisk被誤譯成蛇髮女妖。

data/0/entries/7/entries/7/entries/1.english: Any violent conflict draws the attention of the drow guards, who initially order any prisoners to stand down from a fight, threatening them with hand crossbows from outside the gate. If necessary, they shoot prisoners with poisoned crossbow bolts to incapacitate them. (See {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Poisons} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for information on {@item drow poison}.) The guards let any fight play out for their own amusement as long as the prisoners don't seem likely to actually kill one another.
data/0/entries/7/entries/7/entries/1.zh_tw: 任何暴力衝突都會引起卓爾警衛們的注意，他們最初會命令階下囚停止戰鬥，並用牢門外的手弩威脅它們。如有必要，他們會用淬毒弩箭射擊囚犯使其失能。（關於{@item drow poison||卓爾毒藥}的資訊，請參閱{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Poisons}的{@i 城主指南}。）只要囚犯們看起來不太可能真的互相殘殺，警衛們就會讓任何戰鬥繼續下去以供他們自己娛樂。
data/0/entries/7/entries/7/entries/1.reason: gate在此為牢門，不是異界之門法術；hand crossbows是手弩。

data/16/entries/5/entries/6/entries/0.english: The fate of Gromph Baenre, instigator of chaos and Vizeran's rival, remains a mystery. If he yet lives, his role in recent events earns him many new enemies. Matron Mother {@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA} handpicks a new Archmage of Menzoberranzan to replace her troublesome brother, knowing Gromph will not be found until he chooses to reappear.
data/16/entries/5/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: 作為混亂的煽動者和維茲蘭的對手，貢夫·班瑞的命運仍然是個謎。如果他仍然活著，他在最近事件中的角色為他贏得了許多新的敵人。女族長{@creature Quenthel Baenre|OotA|奎恩瑟·班瑞}親自挑選了新的魔索布萊城大法師，以取代她麻煩的兄弟，因為她知道貢夫在決定重新出現之前是不會被找到的。
data/16/entries/5/entries/6/entries/0.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/5/entries/23/entries/0.english: When the drow attacked Blingdenstone, Ogrémoch's Bane retreated to the far corners of the ruined city, waiting for the time to reemerge and seek out earth elementals to corrupt. The malevolent entity didn't have to wait long, as the drow sent teams of scavengers to loot the treasures the deep gnomes left behind, bringing their own elemental creatures with them.
data/5/entries/23/entries/0.zh_tw: 當卓爾攻擊布靈登石城時，歐雷莫克之災撤退到了這座被毀城市的最遠角落，等待時機重新出現並尋找土元素來腐化。這個惡毒的實體沒有等待太久，因為卓爾派遣了清道夫團隊去掠奪地底侏儒留下的寶藏，並且帶來了他們自己的元素生物。
data/5/entries/23/entries/0.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/13/e.english: A search of the platform uncovers a similar but broken statue near a locked iron chest and a pile of books (see "Treasure" for more information on the chest and books). The broken statue is similar to the statue in the circle, except it has the name "Rihuud" carved into its back and its second head is fully formed. If Rihuud is dead, the broken statue turns to dust when the characters touch it. If the characters spared Rihuud's life, a successful {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) check reveals that the second head is a conduit for the curse's magic, and that removing it and returning it to Stonespeaker Hgraam in Cairngorm Cavern will allow the elder giant to end Rihuud's curse.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/13/e.zh_tw: 對平臺的搜尋揭示了一個類似但破損的雕像，位於一個鎖著的鐵箱和一摞書旁邊（有關箱子和書籍的更多資訊，請參閱"寶藏"部分）。這尊破損的雕像與圓圈中的雕像相似，不同之處在於它的背面刻有名字"裡胡德"，而且它的第二顆頭已經完全形成。如果裡胡德已死，當角色觸控這尊破損的雕像時，它會化為塵土。如果角色饒恕了裡胡德的性命，一次成功的{@dc 12}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定將揭示第二顆頭是詛咒魔法的傳導器，將其移除並歸還給凱恩戈姆洞穴的石語者哈格拉姆將允許這位巨人長老解除裡胡德的詛咒。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/13/e.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/5/entries/23/entries/7/entries/3.english: Unless the characters quickly retreat whence they came, the {@creature ghost} of a svirfneblin named Udhask appears. It uses Horrifying Visage, then attacks with his Withering Touch. If it takes any damage, the ghost shouts "They are coming! Everyone must hide!" It then flees. The characters can follow the fleeing ghost to an old burrow, where it disappears. Within the burrow, Udhask's skeletal remains lie next to a stone bed. There's no evidence that he died a violent death. In fact, when the drow attacked Blingdenstone, Udhask had a heart attack and died while reaching for his loot (see "Treasure").
data/5/entries/23/entries/7/entries/3.zh_tw: 除非角色們迅速撤退，否則名為烏達斯克的地底侏儒的{@creature ghost||幽魂}就會出現。它使用恐怖面容，然後用其枯萎之觸攻擊。如果它受到任何傷害，鬼魂就會大喊"他們來了！每個人都必須躲藏！"然後逃跑。角色們可以跟隨逃跑的鬼魂到達一個古老的洞穴，在那裡它消失了。在洞穴內，烏達斯克的骸骨躺在一張石床旁邊。沒有跡象表明他是在暴力中死去的。實際上，當卓爾攻擊布靈登石城時，烏達斯克在伸手拿他的戰利品（見"寶藏"）時心臟病發作而死。
data/5/entries/23/entries/7/entries/3.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/5/entries/12/entries/1/entries/3/en.english: Some of the connecting tunnels in Blingdenstone are trapped. The most common traps are collapsing roofs and spiked pits (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). Many tunnels slope down before rising up again, allowing the gnomes to flood them. All tunnel traps are inactive in Inner Blingdenstone, but the svirfneblin can quickly activate them in case of emergency.
data/5/entries/12/entries/1/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 在布靈登石城的一些連線隧道中設有陷阱。最常見的陷阱是塌陷的屋頂和尖刺坑（見{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}，選自{@i 城主指南}第5章）。許多隧道先向下傾斜，然後再次上升，使侏儒們可以將其淹沒。在內布靈登石城的隧道陷阱均處於非啟用狀態，但在緊急情況下，斯維爾夫涅布林可以迅速啟用它們。
data/5/entries/12/entries/1/entries/3/en.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/5/entries/22/entries/2/entries/1/it.english: A svirfneblin caravan returning from Whiteshell Mines encountered a parade of dancing myconids. Through their rapport spores, the myconids told the gnomes about a "wedding celebration," which is strange considering that myconids don't celebrate or have weddings. (See {@area chapter 5|252|x} for more information.)
data/5/entries/22/entries/2/entries/1/it.zh_tw: 一支從白貝殼礦井返回的斯里布涅布林商隊遇到了一群跳舞的菌人。透過它們的共鳴孢子，菌人告訴侏儒們這是一場"婚禮慶典"，這很奇怪，因為菌人並不慶祝或舉辦婚禮。（更多資訊請參見{@area 第五章|252|x}。）
data/5/entries/22/entries/2/entries/1/it.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/4/entries/15/entries/3/entries/5/en.english: The moans of the garden's victims suddenly take on a new tone of fear as something moves across the foul ground. A disgusting larval creature rises up before you, showing only vestigial fungal growths that hint that it might once have been a myconid.
data/4/entries/15/entries/3/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 隨著某種東西在骯髒的地面上移動，花園受害者的呻吟突然帶上了新的恐懼調子。一個令人作嘔的幼蟲狀生物出現在你們面前，只顯示出殘餘的真菌生長，暗示它可能曾經是一個菌類生物。
data/4/entries/15/entries/3/entries/5/en.reason: 核對原文身分，統一譯名並修正種族誤譯。

data/15/entries/2/entries/5.english: Zuggtmoy, the demon queen who has corrupted the myconids, has made her intentions clear. She is leading her new followers to the vast cavern complex occupied by Araumycos, the largest life-form in the Underdark and perhaps in all the world. There, the two will be bonded in a demonic ceremony, giving Zuggtmoy dominion over a fungal kingdom larger and greater than any surface-world realm. To that end, she and her followers have been performing rituals and releasing spores to lull the great Araumycos into a kind of {@condition charmed} sleep. The full implications are unclear to Basidia and the myconids, but as Araumycos is the oldest and most powerful being known to them, they greatly fear what Zuggtmoy's corruption of it will bring.
data/15/entries/2/entries/5.zh_tw: 祖格莫伊，這位已經腐蝕了菌人的惡魔女王，已經明確了她的意圖。她正帶領著她的新追隨者前往被阿勞麥柯佔領的廣闊洞穴群，阿勞麥柯是幽暗地域乃至全世界最大的生命形式。在那裡，兩者將在一個惡魔儀式中結合，賦予祖格莫伊對一個比任何地表王國都要龐大和偉大的真菌王國的統治權。為此，她和她的追隨者一直在進行儀式並釋放孢子，使偉大的阿勞麥柯進入一種被{@condition charmed||魅惑}的睡眠狀態。巴斯狄亞和菌人對全部的影響尚不清楚，但作為他們所知最古老且最強大的存在，他們非常擔心祖格莫伊的腐蝕將帶來什麼後果。
data/15/entries/2/entries/5.reason: myconid在此指菌人，不是泛指真菌。

data/15/entries/2/entries/9.english: Basidia and its followers can meet the adventurers within Araumycos's vast cavern complex. The sovereign is too closely watched to slip away and meet them before that, and it recommends that the characters avoid contact with other myconids on their travels. Basidia can use the extended rapport link to fix on the characters' location, and promises to find them when they are near the center of Araumycos. The vision then ends.
data/15/entries/2/entries/9.zh_tw: 巴斯狄亞及其追隨者可以在阿勞麥柯廣闊的洞穴群中與冒險家們會面。由於菌人君主被監視得過於嚴密，無法在此之前溜走與他們會面，它建議角色們在旅途中避免與其他菌人接觸。巴斯狄亞可以使用擴充套件的聯絡連結來確定角色們的位置，並承諾當他們接近阿勞麥柯的中心時會找到他們。幻象隨之結束。
data/15/entries/2/entries/9.reason: myconid在此指菌人，不是泛指真菌。

data/15/entries/5/entries/3/entries/5.english: A successful {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Nature}) check confirms that the characters are in no physical danger but are entering rapport with Araumycos. The adventurers are {@condition paralyzed} as the myconid spores fully take effect. Even creatures immune to sleep and paralysis are affected as the spores seep into mind and body. The characters collapse harmlessly to the soft surface of Araumycos, its fungus quickly spreading across them as the rapport begins. When this happens, continue with "Into the Gray Dream."
data/15/entries/5/entries/3/entries/5.zh_tw: 一次成功的 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘} 或 {@skill Nature||自然}）檢定確認角色們沒有身體上的危險，而是正在與阿勞麥柯建立心靈共鳴。冒險者們被 {@condition paralyzed||麻痺}，因為菌人的孢子完全生效了。即使對睡眠和麻痺免疫的生物也會受到影響，因為孢子滲透進了他們的心靈和身體。角色們無害地倒在阿勞麥柯柔軟的表面上，真菌迅速在他們身上蔓延，心靈共鳴開始形成。當這種情況發生時，繼續"進入灰色夢境"部分的劇情。
data/15/entries/5/entries/3/entries/5.reason: myconid在此指菌人，不是泛指真菌。

data/15/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.english: Through your link with Basidia, you sense that Zuggtmoy's wedding ceremony has begun. Receiving the myconid's impressions, you become aware of a huge crowd of fungal creatures and spore servants—hundreds, perhaps thousands of them—watching as a grotesque procession makes its way through them. Myconids of all sizes caper madly before a troupe of giant animated mushrooms, bearing a mossy litter upon which sits the Demon Queen of Fungi in all her terrible splendor.
data/15/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 透過與巴斯狄亞的聯絡，你感覺到祖格莫伊的婚禮儀式已經開始。接收到菌人的印象，你意識到有一大群真菌生物和孢子僕從——可能有數百甚至數千個——觀看著一個怪異的遊行隊伍穿過他們。各種大小的菌人在一群巨大的活化蘑菇前瘋狂地跳躍，它們抬著一個長滿苔蘚的轎子，上面坐著真菌惡魔女王，她以她可怕的輝煌出現。
data/15/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.reason: myconid在此指菌人，不是泛指真菌。

data/15/entries/9/entries/0.english: The characters might overcome two demon lords if they are successful in this chapter. If they fail, terrible consequences unfold for the myconids and other creatures of the Underdark, though the adventurers will get another chance to take the fight to Zuggtmoy, Juiblex, and all the other demon lords in {@adventure chapter 17|OotA|16}.
data/15/entries/9/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果冒險者們在這一章節中成功，他們可能會戰勝兩位惡魔領主。如果他們失敗，對於菌人和其他幽暗地域的生物來說，可怕的後果將會展開，儘管冒險者們將有另一個機會在{@adventure 第十七章|OotA|16}中向祖格莫伊、朱庇萊克斯以及所有其他惡魔領主發起戰鬥。
data/15/entries/9/entries/0.reason: myconid在此指菌人，不是泛指真菌。

data/15/entries/10/entries/0.english: Even if Araumycos survives, its fate is unclear. The entity's mind has clearly been damaged by both the necessity of cutting away its corruption and the buffeting force of the psychic wind that followed. Basidia and the myconids offer to meld with Araumycos to try to heal it and guide it back to wholeness. Though not as serious as death, the trauma still causes a significant amount of fungal die-off in areas of the creature's domain, potentially uncovering lost ruins or other hidden sites.
data/15/entries/10/entries/0.zh_tw: 即使阿勞麥柯存活下來，它的命運也不清楚。實體的思想顯然已經被切除腐敗的必要性和隨之而來的心靈風暴的力量所破壞。巴斯狄亞和菌人願意與阿勞麥柯融合，試圖治癒它並引導它恢復完整。雖然不像死亡那麼嚴重，但這次創傷仍然在生物領域的某些地區引起了大量的真菌死亡，可能會揭露出失落的廢墟或其他隱藏地點。
data/15/entries/10/entries/0.reason: myconid在此指菌人，不是泛指真菌。

data/0/entries/8/entries/1/entries/4/ent.english: Jorlan thought that Lolth favored him, or at least that his charms had deflected her malice, until he had the misfortune of a run-in with a black pudding on an otherwise routine raid. Ilvara's healing magic saved his life but couldn't undo the terrible damage wrought by the ooze's acid. With his once-handsome face melted and scarred, and his sword hand twisted and missing two fingers, Jorlan was no longer the warrior he once was.
data/0/entries/8/entries/1/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 喬蘭曾認為羅絲眷顧他，或者至少他的個人魅力已經轉移了她的惡意，直到他在一次平常的突襲中不幸遭遇了一隻黑色史萊姆。伊爾瓦拉的治癒魔法救了他的命，但無法消除史萊姆酸液造成的可怕傷害。他曾經英俊的面容被融化和留下疤痕，他的劍手扭曲且失去了兩個手指，喬蘭不再是他曾經的戰士。
data/0/entries/8/entries/1/entries/4/ent.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/0/entries/9/entries/5/entries/5/ent.english: The eight "eyes" of the spider statue are eight pieces of polished jet—four small ones worth 5 gp each and four larger ones worth 10 gp each. Any non-drow who possesses these gems falls under a curse from Lolth. All spiders and spiderlike creatures attack the bearer of the stones on sight, and such creatures have advantage on checks to detect the possessor of the stones. The curse lasts until all the stones are given into the safekeeping of a drow worshiper of Lolth or the gems are subject to a {@spell remove curse} spell.
data/0/entries/9/entries/5/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 蜘蛛雕像的八個"眼睛"是由八個打磨過的黑玉製成——四個小的價值每個5金幣，四個大的價值每個10金幣。任何非卓爾擁有這些寶石的人都會遭受羅絲的詛咒。所有蜘蛛和類似蜘蛛的生物會在看到寶石持有者時攻擊，並且這些生物在檢定中對發現寶石持有者有優勢。詛咒會持續直到所有的寶石被安全地交給一個卓爾的羅絲信徒保管，或者寶石受到{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術的影響。
data/0/entries/9/entries/5/entries/5/ent.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/0/entries/9/entries/5/entries/13/en.english: The inhabitants of Velkynvelve remain unaware that the recent arrival of the demon lord Juiblex in the Underdark has made this ooze particularly aggressive and malevolent. In addition to attacking any creature in the pool, the ooze surges up to 10 feet out of the pool to attack creatures at its edge. When it does so, creatures within 30 feet of the ooze telepathically sense a voice cry out, "Flesh for the Faceless Lord!"
data/0/entries/9/entries/5/entries/13/en.zh_tw: 隱刃哨所的居民們並不知道惡魔領主朱庇萊克斯最近到達幽暗地域，使得這種軟泥變得特別具有攻擊性和惡意。除了攻擊池中的任何生物外，軟泥還會湧出池外最多10尺來攻擊池邊的生物。當它這樣做時，距離軟泥30尺內的生物會心靈感應地感知到一個聲音呼喊："給無面領主的肉體！"
data/0/entries/9/entries/5/entries/13/en.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/1/entries/15/entries/5/entries/3.english: Juiblex's arrival in the Underdark has granted {@creature Glabbagool|OotA} sentience and awareness. The ooze is genuinely curious about other creatures and wants to learn more about the world. It defends itself if attacked, but doesn't otherwise try to harm the characters, instead asking who they are, where they come from, and why they have come to the temple.
data/1/entries/15/entries/5/entries/3.zh_tw: 朱庇萊克斯降臨幽暗地域，賦予了{@creature Glabbagool|OotA|格拉巴布林}感知力和意識。這個軟泥怪真心對其他生物感到好奇，想要更多地瞭解這個世界。如果遭到攻擊，它會自衛，但除此之外，它不會試圖傷害角色，而是詢問他們是誰，來自哪裡，以及為什麼來到寺廟。
data/1/entries/15/entries/5/entries/3.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/1/entries/16/entries/0.english: In ages past, at the height of Faerûn's great empires of magic, the half-elf sorcerer Brysis of Khaem was interred in a floating tomb. After the fall of the empire of Netheril and its flying cities, Brysis's tomb plummeted into a crevasse and wound up in the Underdark, where it has remained for centuries. The rise of the demon lords has awakened Brysis from the eternal sleep of death as a wraith, served by specters who were once her loyal retainers. Brysis yearns to accumulate enough life force to leave the confines of her tomb, to which her spirit is bound.
data/1/entries/16/entries/0.zh_tw: 在古代，當費倫的魔法帝國處於鼎盛時期時，半精靈法師布莉西絲被安葬在一個漂浮的墓穴中。在尼瑟爾帝國及其飛行城市衰落後，布莉西絲的墓穴墜入裂縫，最終落在了幽暗地域中，在那裡它已經存在了幾個世紀。惡魔領主的崛起喚醒了布莉西絲，使她作為一個邪靈的幽靈從死亡的永恆睡眠中甦醒，由曾經是她忠誠的侍從的幽靈們服侍。布莉西絲渴望積累足夠的生命力，以離開她的靈魂所束縛的墓穴。
data/1/entries/16/entries/0.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/2/entries/0.english: Though its name might evoke images of a single subterranean body of water, the Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals that connect innumerable water-filled caverns and chambers. This vast waterway stretches over a hundred miles across, with ceilings that are miles high in some places and depths that are unfathomable.
data/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 儘管它的名字可能會讓人想象到一個單一的地下水域，但黑暗湖實際上是一個由地下河流、自然隧道和運河組成的網路，它們連線著無數充滿水的洞穴和房間。這個龐大的水道延伸超過一百英里，有些地方的天花板高達數英里，深度深不可測。
data/2/entries/0.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/2/entries/2.english: The adventurers can use the Darklake to reach many destinations in the Underdark. More importantly, water travel makes it difficult for their drow pursuers to track them. The kuo-toa town of Sloobludop is located on the eastern edge of the Darklake, and is a potential source of watercraft and navigational aid. But as they seek out these resources, the characters learn of terrible powers loose in the Underdark—worse than the drow, the kuo-toa, or any other threat of this dark realm.
data/2/entries/2.zh_tw: 冒險者可以利用黑暗湖到達幽暗地域的許多目的地。更重要的是，水上旅行使得他們的地底精靈追蹤者難以追蹤他們。寇濤魚人（寇濤）小鎮斯盧布多普位於黑暗湖的東邊緣，是水上交通工具和導航幫助的潛在來源。但是當他們尋求這些資源時，角色們瞭解到幽暗地域中釋放出了可怕的力量——比地底精靈、寇濤魚人或這個黑暗領域中的任何其他威脅都要糟糕。
data/2/entries/2.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/14/entries/0.english: At the far southeast corner of Gracklstugh's cavern, the entrance to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s lair is guarded by the Keepers of the Flame. Not that anyone would be foolish enough to trespass into the Wyrmsmith's home, but ever since the Gray Ghosts stole a red dragon egg meant to hatch {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}'s successor, the Keepers aren't taking any chances.
data/3/entries/14/entries/0.zh_tw: 在格拉克斯圖格洞穴的東南角，{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}的巢穴入口由火焰守護者守衛著。並不是說會有人愚蠢到擅自進入龍匠的家，但自從灰鬼偷走了一個註定孵化成{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}繼任者的紅龍蛋之後，守護者們就沒有放鬆警惕。
data/3/entries/14/entries/0.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/14/entries/4/entries/6/en.english: The psionic Keepers have sensed a great disturbance in the Underdark—a phenomenon that Gartokkar compares to a hole having been torn through the world. The Keepers have no idea about the demonic incursion, however, and even if the characters tell Gartokkar what they know, he is fixated on the idea that the Gray Ghosts are behind the disturbance, dismissing anything else as delusions, ignorance, or outright lies.
data/3/entries/14/entries/4/entries/6/en.zh_tw: 靈能守護者感知到幽暗地域發生了巨大的動盪——加爾托卡將其比作世界被撕裂了一個洞的現象。然而，守護者們並不知道惡魔入侵的情況，即使角色們告訴加爾托卡他們所知道的，他仍然堅持認為是灰鬼在背後操縱動盪，將其他任何說法都視為幻覺、無知或徹頭徹尾的謊言。
data/3/entries/14/entries/4/entries/6/en.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/14/e.english: If the characters capture and interrogate the derro, he talks willingly if they agree to spare him. He knows as much as the quasits in area 11.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/14/e.zh_tw: 如果角色們捕獲並審問迪洛矮人，只要他們同意饒他一命，他會願意交談。他知道的和區域11中的誇西特（小惡魔s）一樣多。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/14/e.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: The Gray Ghosts believe that the mysterious obelisk in this cavern is an important source of magical power, and they are intent on rebuilding it. The obelisk was broken long ago. However, shards of the obelisk that appear throughout the Underdark are magically absorbed into it as soon as they touch its metal surface. The leaders of the Gray Ghosts are obsessed with finding missing shards and completing this monolith, but not even they know what will happen when the obelisk is made whole again.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 灰影（灰鬼）相信這個洞穴中神秘的方尖碑是魔法力量的重要來源，他們決心重建它。方尖碑很久以前就斷裂了。然而，遍佈幽暗地域的方尖碑碎片一旦接觸到它的金屬表面，就會被神奇地吸收進去。灰影的領袖們痴迷於尋找遺失的碎片並完成這座獨石碑，但即使是他們也不知道當方尖碑再次完整時會發生什麼。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: Any character proficient in {@skill Arcana} can tell that the obelisk's fractures are leaking quasi-magical energy. The character further understands that feeding magical energy into the obelisk might activate its latent magic. Spending a spell slot of any level while touching the obelisk activates it and teleports everyone on the mesa to a location in the Underdark just outside the northwest gate of Gracklstugh.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 任何熟練掌握{@skill Arcana||奧秘}的角色都能察覺到方尖碑的裂縫正在洩露準魔法能量。角色進一步理解到，向方尖碑注入魔法能量可能會啟用其潛在的魔法。在觸控方尖碑的同時消耗任意等級的法術位可以啟用它，並將高原上的每個人傳送到幽暗地域的一個地方，就在格拉克斯圖格西北門外。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: The egg atop the northeast mesa is an unhatched dragon egg that the Gray Ghosts stole from the Keepers of the Flame. The 4-foot-tall, 3-foot-diameter egg weighs 180 pounds, and without fire to keep it warm, the egg can't hatch. If and when the egg does hatch, a {@creature red dragon wyrmling} emerges and bonds with the first creature it sees.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 位於東北方高原上的蛋是一個未孵化的龍蛋，灰影（灰鬼）從火焰守護者那裡偷來的。這個4尺高、3尺直徑的蛋重180磅，沒有火來保持溫暖，蛋就不能孵化。如果蛋孵化了，一隻{@creature red dragon wyrmling||紅龍雛龍}就會出現，並與它看到的第一個生物建立聯絡。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.english: If the characters take the dragon egg to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}, he destroys it and rewards the party with a magical potion or oil plucked from his hoard. If the characters return the egg to the Keepers of the Flame, Gartokkar Xundorn promises them safe passage through Gracklstugh if they mention nothing about the egg to {@creature Themberchaud|OotA}.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.zh_tw: 如果角色們將龍蛋帶給{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}，他會毀掉它，並從他的寶藏中拿出一瓶魔法藥劑或油來獎勵隊伍。如果角色們將蛋歸還給火焰守護者，加爾托卡·桑多恩承諾，如果他們不向{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}提及任何關於蛋的事情，他們將安全透過格拉克斯圖格。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/15/e.reason: 移除基稿額外且重複的同名括註。

data/3/entries/16/entries/1.english: Errde Blackskull is true to her word, and she lets the characters leave the city freely if they fulfilled the tasks she set for them. Working for {@creature Themberchaud|OotA} or the Keepers of the Flame leaves the characters in a position where they can at least avoid arrest in the city.
data/3/entries/16/entries/1.zh_tw: 艾德·黑顱 信守承諾，如果角色們完成了她為他們設定的任務，她會讓他們自由地離開城市。為{@creature Themberchaud|OotA|瑟姆貝爾喬德}或火焰守護者工作，使角色們至少能夠避免在城市中被逮捕。

data/4/entries/2.english: However, this particular myconid haven isn't as safe as it might appear. One of their sovereigns has fallen under the sway of Zuggtmoy, the Demon Queen of Fungi, who wasted no time building herself a stronghold in a colossal mushroom called Yggmorgus. There, she works on a malevolent scheme to claim all the Underdark as her domain. More and more myconids are slowly becoming unwitting thralls under her control, and characters who linger in Neverlight Grove might find themselves in great peril.

data/7/entries/3/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: "The Zhentarim have a stake in a secret Underdark trading post called Mantol-Derith. If ye can get them on our side, they'll guide ye there, where ye can meet with one of their agents, {@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA}. He can provide ye with a map to Gravenhollow. It's a legendary place built by the stone giants long ago, said to contain all the knowledge of the depths. If there's answers to be found for what has happened, ye might find them there. If ye are willing to go back, that is.
data/7/entries/3/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: "渣爾塔利姆（散塔林會）在幽暗地域中有一個名為曼塔-岱瑞絲的秘密貿易站。如果你們能讓他們在我們這邊，他們會引導你們去那裡，在那裡你們可以會見他們的一個代理人，{@creature Ghazrim DuLoc|OotA|加茲裡姆·杜洛克}。他可以提供給你們一張去刻文谷的地圖。這是一個由石頭巨人很久以前建造的傳奇之地，據說包含了深淵的所有知識。如果你們要尋找發生了什麼的答案，你們可能會在那裡找到。如果你們願意回去的話。"

You sense their minds come alive in wonder, and as they kneel in worship, you know they are doomed. A voice sounds out within clouds of spores that fall like snow. data/10/entries/7/entries/5/entries/4/en.english: You see a circle of small hooded figures, their forms hunched and emaciated. Their gestures and movements are jerky, indicative of the madness possessing them. They are chanting, swaying to their own words. And then they stop as the glow of {@i faerzress} rises around them, whispering to them in unintelligible sounds. The derro cackle and dance, their hands glowing with a power that isn't theirs. The vision shifts, and suddenly gray dwarves stare down at the red-hot metal on their anvils. The constant rhythm of their hammering falters. Suddenly, brother turns against brother as minds turn inward upon themselves. Sparks fly and a city burns.
data/10/entries/7/entries/5/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 你看到一群戴著兜帽的小身影，他們的姿態駝背且憔悴。他們的動作抽搐，表明他們被瘋狂所佔據。他們在唸誦，隨著自己的話語搖擺。然後他們停下來，因為{@i 妖光}的光輝在他們周圍升起，用難以理解的聲音對他們耳語。迪洛矮人狂笑並跳舞，他們的手散發著不屬於他們的力量。幻象轉變，突然，灰矮人俯視著他們鐵砧上的熾熱金屬。他們不斷敲打的節奏變得不穩定。突然，兄弟反目成仇，心靈向內轉向自己。火花四濺，一座城市在燃燒。

data/10/entries/7/entries/5/entries/6/en.english: The vision shifts to a brightly lit cavern full of crude merchant stalls, where the duergar hands the gem to a svirfneblin for appraisal. The gnome refuses to return the gem, instead giving it to one of her svirfneblin apprentices. The young apprentice skulks away with the gem in his clutches, but is ambushed by a gargoyle. The gargoyle snatches the gem, flies away, and gives it to a female drow. The drow gazes into the black gemstone and sees a hideous demonic face looking back at her. Thoughts of murder and carnage fill her thoughts as she hides the gemstone on her person, draws her shortsword, and coats the blade with poison.
data/10/entries/7/entries/5/entries/6/en.zh_tw: 幻象轉移到一個明亮的洞穴，裡面佈滿了簡陋的商人攤位，灰矮人將寶石交給斯維爾芬布林（地底侏儒）估價。侏儒拒絕歸還寶石，反而把它給了她的一個斯維爾芬布林學徒。年輕的學徒帶著寶石鬼鬼祟祟地離開，但被一個石像鬼伏擊了。石像鬼搶走了寶石，飛走了，然後把它交給了一個女性卓爾。卓爾凝視著黑色的寶石，看到一張醜陋的惡魔面孔在回望著她。當她把寶石藏在身上，拔出短劍並塗上毒藥時，她的腦海中充滿了謀殺和屠殺的念頭。

You can hear the illithids' incomprehensible thoughts as they mourn its passing. One word echoes louder than the others: Cyrog.

He has given Lolth free reign in the Abyss. My own research leads me to believe Gromph used {@i faerzress} to achieve such a summoning, though I am sure he didn't intend this result. Imbecile!

data/10/entries/8/entries/3.english: Vizeran invites the adventurers and their NPC followers to Araj, his tower and stronghold, where they can discuss the matter further. There, he can demonstrate what he intends to do and why he needs the heroes' help. He refuses to discuss plans in detail in Gravenhollow, saying, "The walls here literally have ears, and echoes linger forever." Only his home is secure enough to serve as the place from which to plan the demon lords' defeat.
data/10/entries/8/entries/3.zh_tw: 維茲蘭邀請冒險家們以及他們的非玩家角色追隨者到阿拉傑，他的塔樓和要塞，在那裡他們可以進一步討論這個問題。在那裡，他可以展示他打算做什麼以及為什麼他需要英雄們的幫助。他拒絕在刻文谷詳細討論計劃，說："這裡的牆壁確實有耳朵，回聲永遠存在。"只有他的家才足夠安全，可以作為計劃擊敗惡魔領主的地方。

data/10/entries/9/entries/1.english: The characters can travel with {@creature Vizeran DeVir|OotA|Vizeran}, or he provides them with a map and precise directions to guide them to Araj if they want to deal with other matters in the Underdark first. He emphasizes that time is of the essence. Every day the characters tarry allows the demon lords' power and influence in the Underdark to grow. data/11/entries/6/entries/4/entries/1.english: Consigned to solitude in the Underdark, Vizeran didn't perish as most assumed he would. Instead, he put his arcane powers to work to create a safe haven for himself, and spent the following centuries in isolated study, furthering his mastery of the magical arts. He has watched from afar as countless events unfolded in the Underdark and across Faerûn, gathering information and making plans for his eventual return. After waiting for centuries, Vizeran now believes that time has come.
data/11/entries/6/entries/4/entries/1.zh_tw: 維茲蘭被放逐到幽暗地域中，與大多數人所假設的不同，他並沒有死去。相反，他運用自己的奧術力量為自己創造了一個安全的避難所，並在隨後的幾個世紀裡進行孤立的研究，進一步提升了他對魔法藝術的掌握。他從遠處觀察了幽暗地域和費倫上無數事件的發展，收集資訊併為他的最終迴歸制定計劃。經過數個世紀的等待，維茲蘭現在相信時機已經到來。

data/15/entries/3/entries/3/entries/2/en.english: Fungal life fills the caverns and passageways in the region, with visitors literally walking upon and within Araumycos upon entering its domain. The floor is carpeted with thick mold and fungus, creating patches of {@quickref difficult terrain||3} throughout. In some tunnels and caves, fungi growths obstruct passage. Characters either have to climb or hack their way through the fungal growth. In other places, the fungus covering the floor is soft enough that characters can sink into it with no warning. Use the quicksand rules in chapter 5, "{@book Adventure Environments|DMG|5|Quicksand}," of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for such areas. Creatures that fail to escape become food for Araumycos.
data/15/entries/3/entries/3/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 真菌生命充滿了該區域的洞穴和通道，訪客在進入其領域時實際上是走在阿勞麥柯之上和其中。地面上鋪滿了厚厚的黴菌和真菌，形成了遍佈的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。在一些隧道和洞穴中，真菌的生長阻礙了通行。角色們要麼需要攀爬，要麼得砍出一條穿過真菌生長的路。在其他地方，覆蓋地面的真菌柔軟到足以讓角色不知不覺地陷入其中。使用第五章"{@book 冒險環境|DMG|5|Quicksand}"中的{@i 城主指南}中的流沙規則來處理這些區域。未能逃脫的生物將成為阿勞麥柯的食物。

data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/5/ent.english: The lairds and merchants who sit at this council make sure that trade and commerce flow smoothly. They employ slave labor to maintain trade routes in the dangerous Underdark, and are always open to hiring explorers to check out leads on potential new routes. Expendable outsiders hired as caravan guards always take point and receive little aid or support from the caravan masters. Despite these unfair assignments, the duergar always live up to their bargains, paying survivors as promised.
data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 坐在這個議會中的領主和商人確保貿易和商業順暢進行。他們僱傭奴隸勞動力來維護危險的幽暗地域中的貿易路線，並且總是願意僱傭探險家去調查潛在的新路線。作為商隊護衛被僱傭的可消耗的外來者總是擔任先鋒，並且從商隊首領那裡得到很少的援助或支援。儘管這些任務不公平，灰矮人總是履行他們的協議，按承諾向生還者支付報酬。
data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/5/ent.reason: caravan masters 是商隊負責人，與伊爾莎段落一致。

data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/11/e.english: The two {@creature derro|OotA} (see {@adventure appendix C|OotA|19}) are cultists. One of them is complaining about "the master" while the other talks about something he once fished out of the Darklake.
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/11/e.zh_tw: 那兩個{@creature derro|OotA|迪洛矮人}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|OotA|19}）是邪教徒。其中一個正在抱怨"主人"，而另一個則在談論他曾經從黑暗湖中釣出來的東西。
data/3/entries/15/entries/7/entries/11/e.reason: 邪教徒抱怨服從的上位者，非技藝稱號。

data/11/entries/6/entries/6/entries/1.english: Grin is loyal to his master but not well suited to such a solitary existence. He longs for the opportunity to return to Menzoberranzan, supporting the notion of an uprising to overthrow the matron mothers and end their rule. He is less enthused about the potential of turning his old home into a battlefield for the demon lords, however, and he eventually betrays Vizeran's confidence to the adventurers in an effort to prevent that outcome (see chapter 15, "{@adventure The City of Spiders|OotA|14}").
data/11/entries/6/entries/6/entries/1.zh_tw: 格林對他的師父忠誠，但並不太適應這種孤獨的生活。他渴望有機會返回魔索布萊城，支援起義推翻主母們並結束她們的統治。然而，他對於將他的故鄉變成惡魔領主戰場的可能性不太熱衷，最終他為了阻止這一結果，背叛了維茲蘭的信任，向冒險家們透露了這一資訊（見第15章，"{@adventure 蜘蛛之城|OotA|14}"）。
data/11/entries/6/entries/6/entries/1.reason: 格林是維茲蘭持續教導魔法的學徒。

data/14/entries/12/entries/0.english: At some point as the characters explore Menzoberranzan, Grin Ousstyl confesses that his master Vizeran has not been entirely truthful with the adventurers. (If Grin didn't accompany the characters to the city, he pursues and eventually catches up with them to share what he knows.)
data/14/entries/12/entries/0.zh_tw: 在角色們探索魔索布萊城的過程中，格林·奧斯提爾承認他的師父維茲蘭並沒有完全對冒險家們誠實。（如果格林沒有陪同角色們來到這座城市，他會追趕並最終趕上他們，分享他所知道的資訊。）
data/14/entries/12/entries/0.reason: 格林是維茲蘭持續教導魔法的學徒。

data/14/entries/12/entries/1.english: Grin has studied Vizeran's work in crafting the {@i dark heart} talisman and its associated ritual to draw the demon lords together, and he believes that the ritual will have its intended effect regardless of where the talisman is placed. It doesn't need to be placed in Sorcere, or even in Menzoberranzan. Placing the talisman there only ensures that the drow city becomes the site of the demon lords' battle—and might well be laid waste in the process. If pressed, Grin admits that he isn't absolutely certain that Vizeran's ritual will work if the talisman is placed elsewhere. He's not as learned or powerful as his master.
data/14/entries/12/entries/1.zh_tw: 格林研究了維茲蘭製作{@i 黑暗之心}護身符及其相關的儀式，以吸引惡魔領主聚集在一起，他認為無論護身符放置在哪裡，儀式都會產生預期的效果。它不需要被放置在索瑟瑞，甚至不需要在魔索布萊城。將護身符放置在那裡只確保了卓爾城市成為惡魔領主戰鬥的地點——並且在此過程中很可能會被摧毀。如果被追問，格林承認他並不完全確定如果護身符被放置在其他地方，維茲蘭的儀式是否會奏效。他沒有他的師父那樣博學或強大。
data/14/entries/12/entries/1.reason: 格林是維茲蘭持續教導魔法的學徒。

data/16/entries/2/entries/3/entries/2.english: A character can figure out the truth with a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, or by consulting Gromph Baenre's grimoire (see {@area chapter 15|570|x}). Alternatively, Grin Ousstyl can tell the characters the truth, enraging his master as a result.
data/16/entries/2/entries/3/entries/2.zh_tw: 角色可以透過進行一次 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，或透過查閱貢夫·班瑞的魔法書（參見 {@area 第十五章|570|x}）來找出真相。另外，格林·奧斯提爾可以告訴角色真相，但這樣做會激怒他的師父。
data/16/entries/2/entries/3/entries/2.reason: 格林是維茲蘭持續教導魔法的學徒。

data/8/entries/5/entries/1.english: Anyone who touches the gem risks falling prey to delusional madness. A duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt found the gem and took it to Mantol-Derith. By the time he arrived, Krimgol had succumbed to the delusion that he was a {@i calassabrak}—a duergar without honor. He paid Yantha Coaxrock, an honest svirfneblin mage, to appraise the jewel, hoping that he could use it to buy back the goodwill of his clan. Touched by the gem's madness, Yantha lied to Krimgol and told him the gem was worthless. She offered a lump of gold in exchange, whereupon Krimgol suspected treachery and demanded the gem's immediate return. While Krimgol and Yantha argued, one of Yantha's apprentices tried to hide the gem for his mistress but succumbed to its evil power. The apprentice, Flink, took the gem to the drow enclave, hoping to trade it for some rare spell components that he imagined Yantha needing to make Krimgol go away. A gargoyle assigned to watch for thieves spotted the gem and wrested it from Flink, who hid for fear of incurring Yantha's wrath. Soon thereafter, the delusional gargoyle laid eyes on a drow assassin named {@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA} and was instantly smitten by her. The gargoyle gave her the black gem as a token of its devotion, which she, in her madness, mistook as a payment from the drow enclave to assassinate {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}, a maimed beholder allied with the Zhentarim.
data/8/entries/5/entries/1.zh_tw: 任何觸控寶石的人都可能陷入妄想的瘋狂。一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人麥芽酒商人發現了這塊寶石，並將其帶到曼塔-岱瑞絲。到他到達時，克林戈已經陷入了妄想，認為自己是一個沒有榮譽的灰矮人{@i 卡拉薩布拉克}。他付錢給一個誠實的地底侏儒法師揚薩·寇克斯洛克來評估這顆寶石，希望他能用它來買回他部族的好感。揚薩在寶石的瘋狂影響下，對克林戈撒謊說寶石毫無價值。她提供了一塊金子作為交換，於是克林戈懷疑有陰謀並要求立即歸還寶石。當克林戈和揚薩爭論時，揚薩的一個學徒試圖為他的師父藏起寶石，但屈服於它的邪惡力量。這個學徒，弗林克，帶著寶石去了卓爾的飛地，希望用它交換一些他認為揚薩需要的稀有法術成分，以讓克林戈離開。一隻被指派守望小偷的石像鬼發現了寶石，並從弗林克手中奪走了它，弗林克因害怕招致揚薩的憤怒而躲藏起來。不久之後，陷入妄想的石像鬼看到了一個名叫{@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA|金耶爾·德魯吉爾}的卓爾刺客，並立刻被她迷住了。石像鬼將黑色寶石作為其忠誠的象徵送給了她，而她在瘋狂中誤以為這是來自卓爾飛地的報酬，以暗殺與散塔林會結盟的受傷的眼魔{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}。
data/8/entries/5/entries/1.reason: 弗林克是揚薩的魔法學徒，非主僕。

data/8/entries/16/entries/2/entries/4/en.english: Huddled against a stone column at the edge of the fungi grove is a cowardly {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Flink. He suffers from a form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) that makes him want to please his mistress, Yantha Coaxrock, and also causes him to be deathly afraid of her. He uses his Stone Camouflage feature to blend in with the rocky terrain, afraid that the drow and the gargoyles might attack him. If he sees the characters, he runs toward them in a panic, babbling about a stolen gem. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion}) check or {@spell calm emotions} spell allows Flink to speak coherently, whereupon he reveals the following information:
data/8/entries/16/entries/2/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 蜷縮在真菌林邊緣一根石柱旁的是一個名叫弗林克的膽小 {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}。他患有一種永久性瘋狂形式（參見 {@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，位於 {@i 城主指南} 第八章），這讓他想要取悅他的師父揚薩·寇克斯洛克，同時也讓他對她極度恐懼。他利用他的石膚偽裝特性與岩石地形融為一體，害怕卓爾和石像鬼可能會攻擊他。如果他看到角色們，他會驚慌失措地向他們跑去，語無倫次地提及一顆被盜的寶石。成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定或 {@spell calm emotions||安定心神} 法術能讓弗林克有條理地說話，此時他會透露以下資訊：
data/8/entries/16/entries/2/entries/4/en.reason: 弗林克是揚薩的魔法學徒，非主僕。

data/8/entries/16/entries/2/entries/4/en.english: A duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt asked Flink's mistress, Yantha Coaxrock, to appraise a large black gemstone. For reasons unknown to Flink, Yantha didn't want to give the gemstone back to the duergar and instead offered him a lump of gold in trade. An argument ensued.
data/8/entries/16/entries/2/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人啤酒商人請弗林克的師父，揚薩·寇克斯洛克，評估一顆大黑寶石。出於弗林克不知道的原因，揚薩不想將寶石歸還給灰矮人，而是向他提供了一塊金子作為交換。隨後發生了爭論。

data/13/entries/13/entries/5/entries/2/e.english: This angel reaches toward the ceiling, its face a mask of hatred. A creature that makes contact with this angel must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking {@dice 3d6} psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
data/13/entries/13/entries/5/entries/2/e.zh_tw: 這個天使向天花板伸出手，滿臉仇恨。任何與之接觸的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 {@dice 3d6} 點心靈傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。
data/13/entries/13/entries/5/entries/2/e.reason: mask of hatred 描述表情，不是道具。

data/2/entries/12/entries/2/entries/3/en.english: It might well be that the kuo-toa's former masters—the mind flayers—used them as ferry pilots and navigators in the Underdark, and the fish-folk continue to do so out of habit or some deep-seated need. Certainly, their relative usefulness to the other races of the Underdark has served the kuo-toa well. Only the duergar have shown any interest in navigating the waters of the Darklake on their own, and not even they do it as well as the kuo-toa.
data/2/entries/12/entries/2/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 很可能寇濤魚人的前主人——靈吸怪——在幽暗地域中使用他們作為渡船舵手和領航員，而魚人出於習慣或某種根深蒂固的需求繼續這樣做。當然，他們對幽暗地域其他種族的相對有用性對寇濤魚人來說很有幫助。只有灰矮人表現出了獨自航行黑暗湖水域的興趣，甚至他們也沒有寇濤魚人做得好。
data/2/entries/12/entries/2/entries/3/en.reason: ferry pilots 指渡船駕駛，非飛行員。

data/11/entries/8/entries/2/entries/0.english: "The only one of my kind who could ever match me in the Art is Gromph Baenre. I think we knew from the moment we met that we were destined to be rivals. But where I sought only to master the Art, Gromph was also an astute political manipulator. No more devout than I in the service of the Spider Queen, he arranged for my disgrace and exile. Deprived of my considerable skills, my house fell to our rival, House Do'Urden. Gromph became the Archmage of Menzoberranzan under the auspices of his own house, the First House of the Ruling Council.
data/11/entries/8/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: "唯一一個在魔法技藝上能與我匹敵的我的同類是貢夫·班瑞。我認為從我們見面的那一刻起，我們就知道我們註定要成為對手。但我尋求的只是掌握魔法技藝，貢夫也是一個精明的政治操縱者。他並不比我更虔誠地為蜘蛛女王服務，他安排了我的恥辱和流放。失去了我相當的能力，我的家族倒在了我們的對手杜堊登家族手中。貢夫在自己的家族，統治委員會的第一家族的支援下，成為了魔索布萊城的大法師。"
data/11/entries/8/entries/2/entries/0.reason: 維茲蘭與貢夫競爭的 Art 為施法技藝。

data/7/entries/4/entries/10/entries/2.english: The Underdark has always been a proving ground for candidates of the order, as well as a frequent destination for veteran paladins, monks, and clerics looking to smite evil. It hasn't taken long for reports of new threats rising in the Underdark to reach the order.
data/7/entries/4/entries/10/entries/2.zh_tw: 幽暗地域一直是該教團候選人的試煉場，也是經驗豐富的聖武士、僧侶和牧師尋求打擊邪惡的常去之地。關於幽暗地域新威脅上升的報告很快就傳到了教團中。

data/7/entries/4/entries/12.english: If he's of a mind to provide aid, Sir Lanniver pledges five human veterans of the order to the party's mission. The veterans' names are Thora Nabal, Sylrien Havennor, Olaf Renghyi, Elias Drako, and Tamryn Tharke. Sir Lanniver can also offer a member of the party a {@item +1 warhammer}, one of a handful of treasures held in trust by the order. He prefers to bestow this weapon on a good- or neutral-aligned cleric or paladin. Feel free to swap this magic weapon with another magic item more useful to the adventurers.
data/7/entries/4/entries/12.zh_tw: 如果他願意提供幫助，蘭尼弗爵士承諾向隊伍的任務提供五名人類老兵。這些老兵的名字是索拉·納巴爾、西爾裡恩·哈文諾、奧拉夫·倫吉、伊萊亞斯·德拉科和塔姆林·薩克。蘭尼弗爵士還可以向隊伍的一名成員提供一件{@item +1 warhammer||+1 戰錘}，這是教團保管的少數寶藏之一。他更願意將這件魔法武器贈予善良或中立陣營的牧師或聖武士。如果這把魔法武器對冒險者來說不如其他魔法物品有用，請隨意更換。

data/7/entries/4/entries/20/entries/1.english: The Lords' Alliance is a political and economic coalition of cities spread throughout the North and the Sword Coast. The alliance owes its success to effective cooperation and diplomacy between its members, who work to align their separate settlements toward a mutual purpose. This cooperation is easier during times of crisis, making the Lords' Alliance a powerful force when threats require a united front. The agents of the Lords' Alliance work to maintain the delicate network of information and diplomacy that sustains their order, alert for anything that might threaten the alliance's interests. Recent reports of unusual activity from the Underdark might mark one such threat.
data/7/entries/4/entries/20/entries/1.zh_tw: 領主聯盟是一個政治和經濟聯盟，其城市遍佈北方和劍海岸。聯盟的成功歸功於其成員之間有效的合作和外交，他們共同努力將各自的定居點統一到一個共同的目標。在危機時期，這種合作更容易實現，使領主聯盟在需要團結一致的威脅面前成為一個強大的力量。領主聯盟的代理人致力於維護維持他們聯盟的複雜資訊和外交網路，警惕任何可能威脅到聯盟利益的事情。最近有關幽暗地域異常活動的報告可能標誌著這樣一個威脅。
